ArrayLeaRNA is an efficient and reliable method for analysing gene expression profiles.
ArrayLeaRNA is a robust method that can be used for analysing microarrays and can be applied to both cDNA and genomic DNA microarray data.

the development of a new approach for the analysis of microarray expression profiles, which is based on genomic DNA controls and on predicted operon structure, and is shown to be more reliable than existing approaches.
improving the quality of gene expression data analysis and with providing an easy to use, user-friendly tool for this purpose.
the development of a novel method that is applicable to a wide variety of datasets.

ArrayLeaRNA has the advantage over OpWise in that it uses the genomic DNA control features as a normalization tool and it is more robust in the estimation of experimental variability.

ArrayLeaRNA is a powerful and robust method for the normalization, the estimation of the statistical significance of differential expression and for the classification of genes in expression datasets.
the Bayesian approach is more robust than the two fold cut-off and OpWise approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ArrayLeaRNA is a robust method which can improve the quality of data analysis and the reliability of the results.
ArrayLeaRNA is a robust tool which can be used in microarray data processing and interpretation.

the use of genomic DNA features in the normalization process and the Bayesian modelling approach, in which the experimental variability of each hybridization is taken into account, is superior to the LOWESS normalization followed either by a cut-off criterion or by the OpWise model.

genomic control features can be used for normalization and for the estimation of the parameters in the Bayesian model and that the use of predicted operon information improves the classification of genes.
the use of genomic DNA control hybridization data is an effective means to estimate the parameters of the statistical model and to improve data normalization.
the use of genomic DNA control hybridizations can improve the quality of the normalization and of the estimation of the variability of expression measurements.
